xy.fix_x_y_amplitudes_independently_of_t.source: Fix X/Y amplitudes independently of the moving trace. Measure ΔX and ΔY.

xy.follow_a_real_sample_at_a_fixed_time_.source: Follow a real sample at a fixed time offset from the XY trigger. Uses Scope trigger settings.

xy.free_click_or_drag_to_fix_x_y_amplitu.source: Free: click or drag to fix X/Y amplitudes. A/B measure ΔX and ΔY independently of the moving trace. Free positions are retained when switching to Trace Snap.

xy.free_keeps_x_y_amplitudes_fixed_and_r.source: Free keeps X/Y amplitudes fixed and reads ΔX/ΔY. Cursor positions are retained when switching modes.

xy.source_changes_apply_on_start_held_xy.source: Source changes apply on Start. Held XY keeps its channels.

xy.trace_snap_follows_a_trigger_relative.source: Trace Snap follows a trigger-relative sample. Auto/free run may move the marker; Stop freezes it.

xy.trace_snap_selects_the_nearest_actual.source: Trace Snap: selects the nearest actual pair from the assigned X/Y channels and keeps its sample offset from the XY trigger. Uses Scope's trigger source, edge and level. Without a crossing, the reference moves with the latest window. Overlapping points select the latest sample; Stop freezes the capture.

xy.up_to_real_sample_pairs_longer_window.source: Up to %{xy} real sample pairs; longer windows show the latest portion.

xy.x_y_use_the_same_input_frame_equal_ax.source: X/Y use the same input frame. Equal axis scales preserve circles on the square plot.

xy.xy_requires_at_least_two_input_channe.source: XY requires at least two input channels.
